summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of Prompt Optimizer (FastAPI + React + MongoDB + Nvidia NIM + Emergent Google Auth). 15/15 backend pytest cases passed including real NIM calls. Full UI flow verified via Playwright using injected session cookie (Google OAuth not exercised). Optimize, save (auto-history), copy, fork, pattern selector, and sidebar tabs all functional. NIM responses return in ~1-3s.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks — migrate to lifespan context manager (FastAPI >=0.93). Non-blocking but produces deprecation warnings.
/api/optimize-prompt logs optimization_runs but does not persist on NIM failure (raises 502 before insert) — acceptable but no audit trail for failures.

/api/suggest does NOT enforce auth-only failures gracefully if use_nim=true and NIM fails, falls back silently — good. However it always returns 200 even for sub-8-char inputs (pattern=None) which is fine but worth documenting.

Frontend axios uses withCredentials:true for cross-origin cookie auth — depends on backend CORS allow_origins not being '*' with credentials. Currently CORS_ORIGINS='*' in backend/.env which technically conflicts with allow_credentials=True (browsers may reject). It works in this preview because same-site routing handles it, but for production this should be restricted to actual frontend origin.
Pattern template_body field is large but returned for every /api/patterns call — acceptable for 6 system patterns; consider pagination/projection if user patterns are added later.
test_credentials: Synthetic MongoDB sessions used (per /app/auth_testing.md). All test users and sessions were cleaned up after run (db.users.deleteMany({email:/^test\./}); db.user_sessions.deleteMany({session_token:/^test_session/}); plus prompts/runs).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All TEST_ prefixed data and synthetic sessions removed post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py with conftest.py (creates synthetic MongoDB session, cleans up). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. For UI: create session via mongosh (see /app/auth_testing.md), then page.context.add_cookies({name:'session_token', domain:'pattern-refine.preview.emergentagent.com', secure:True, httpOnly:True, sameSite:'None'}) before navigating to /app. NIM real calls take 1-8s; optimize endpoint auto-saves to history when save=true. Suggest endpoint requires raw_input >=8 chars to return non-null pattern. CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is a potential cross-origin issue worth flagging in production.
ui_flows_tested: /login renders, Continue with Google button visible
/app loads workbench with injected session_token cookie
Pattern selector dropdown lists all 6 system patterns
Optimize button triggers NIM and produces structured output
Auto-save creates prompt row in history sidebar
Fork button creates new prompt row (parent_prompt_id linkage verified via API)
Copy button clickable; Patterns sidebar tab shows 6 pattern cards
